mapper.insert: INSERT INTO after_sale_log (after_sale_id, user_id, user_type, before_status, after_status, operate_type, content, merchant_remark, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{afterSaleId}, #{userId}, #{userType}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{operateType}, #{content}, #{merchantRemark}, 0, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, after_sale_id, user_id, user_type, before_status, after_status, operate_type, content, merchant_remark, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM after_sale_log WHERE after_sale_id = #{afterSaleId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
